## 94ac5008ffdb

**Reproduced defect — public texture contract and duplicate validator.** The
current generator hash is
`23bf89e281317ff5a6bf8071303c2c05899f5a32ca640c68150f68fb8d3e4519`.
For the exact same seed `123`, sample index `0`, and medium difficulty, all four
advertised helpful `texture` values (`default`, `warm`, `cool`, `varied`)
produce the same grid hash. The source also defines two top-level
`self_check()` functions. The later definition overrides the earlier one, so a
`missing_color` grid is rejected even when called with matching
`meta={"texture": "missing_color"}`; the earlier validator explicitly intended
to bypass declared degenerates.

The independent reproducer and exact hashes are in
`checks/audit/94ac5008ffdb/contract_repro.json`; it can be rerun with
`python3 checks/audit/reproduce_contract_findings.py` from the packet root. The
full audit battery at
`checks/audit-battery-94ac5008ffdb/checks/94ac5008ffdb_before_battery_summary.json`
corroborates the issue: lint fails for the duplicate validator and missing
`RULE_HASH`, defect lint reports four dead textures plus texture-domain overlap,
and override contract fails (including silent acceptance of an unknown key).
Rule smoke, distribution, grammar, Racket lint, and authority sync did pass, so
this finding is about generator contract integrity rather than a reproduced
Racket execution error. No audit-target files were changed.

## 94ac5008ffdb

### Reproduced contract defects: byte-dead axes, overwritten validator, and unknown-axis acceptance

Source audited: generator SHA-256 `23bf89e281317ff5a6bf8071303c2c05899f5a32ca640c68150f68fb8d3e4519`. At seed `123`, index `0`, medium, `helpful_texture` values `default`, `warm`, `cool`, and `varied` all produce the same grid hash `c41adbe65ccd06c35c9abea40cb1b6b15b570fa2a84e6c85372b8df53b4e8ed1`; the corresponding `palette_kind` values are also byte-identical. An unknown override `typo_axis` is silently accepted and gives the same hash.

The source defines `self_check` twice (lines 51 and 192); the later definition overwrites the earlier meta-aware one. A grid matching the advertised `missing_color` texture is rejected with `color 3 has 0 components, expected 1` even when called with `meta={{"texture":"missing_color"}}`. Exact results and the test grid are in `checks/audit/94ac5008ffdb/contract_repro.json`.

The optional portable task-test stage exited 5 because this target has no selected frozen or task-local tests; see `checks/audit/94ac5008ffdb-task-tests/result.json`. That is recorded as no tests, not a pass. No audited source was modified.

### Suggested repair

Choose one validator contract and remove the shadowed definition; reject unknown overrides; either make each advertised texture/palette value observably affect output or remove/rename the dead axes; and add focused tests for every advertised exact value plus the `missing_color` meta path.

triage.reason: Both source-bound audit reports retained with explicit statuses. All eight source-bound reports remain unresolved within their recorded scopes. This does not clear older findings or upgrade audited generators.
